description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wanewatta, Thalawa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110096
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the determination of titles for numerous land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with their owners, extents, and title classifications, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
